name: agentic-flow-builder-runtime
notes: Playwright trace should be configured with retain-on-failure when trace evidence is desired.

The retained trace is written after the worker finishes with the test, so evidence-manager.ts records it by its known path under the project's per-run output directory rather than copying it -- see build-flow.md's Required Playwright Configuration and run-output-retention.ts.
The workspace runtime must not be silently overwritten after initialization.
compatibility-check.ts is the executable readiness gate and must remain aligned with this manifest.
